edit_summary.reason: Fix three critical flaws: (1) crash penalty heuristic misclassifies normal flight as crashes, (2) success bonus fires in non-terminal states creating proxy-success farming, (3) main engine bonus too small. Preserve progress-delta guidance and action coverage improvements from iter_001. Avoid the failed pattern from iter_002 (removing all non-terminal positive incentives).
preserved_design: Progress-delta reward for reducing distance to pad (capped at +5 per step).
Vertical speed shaping to encourage controlled descent.
Angle shaping to encourage upright orientation.
Time penalty to encourage timely landing.
Horizontal velocity penalty to discourage drifting.
No-op penalty to discourage doing nothing.
changed_design: Fix crash penalty: only apply -100 when terminated is True (environment termination), not when legs are not in contact during flight. In LunarLander-v2, termination always means failure (crash or out-of-bounds).
Make success bonus truly terminal-aligned: only pay when the episode terminates with success (both legs contact, near pad, low speed, upright). Use a success_flag to ensure one-shot payment.
Remove repeatable proxy-success payment: success bonus only fires on terminal success, not on non-terminal states.
Increase main engine bonus to +0.5 when distance > 0.5 to provide meaningful incentive for approaching the pad.
Add small bonus (+1.0) for being near the pad (distance < 0.3) with low speed (abs(vy) < 0.5) to encourage stable approach.
Add diagnostics for success_flag and objective_bonus to enable post-training audits.
required_edits_implemented: Increase the distinction between true terminal success and proxy progress states.
Add clearer negative feedback for unsafe terminal behavior without overwhelming exploration.
Make completion/objective bonuses one-shot or terminal-aligned so they cannot fire every step.
Remove repeatable proxy-success payment modes that can be farmed without episode completion.
Keep dense progress signals bounded and smaller than episode-scale objective signals.
Add diagnostics for success_flag/objective_bonus so post-training audits can verify payment count.
forbidden_edits_avoided: Do not increase raw per-step action or engine bonuses (main engine bonus is conditioned on distance > 0.5, not raw per-step).
Do not let objective_bonus exceed roughly one terminal event per episode (success bonus is one-shot).
Do not define success only as a non-terminal state predicate (success is now terminal-aligned).
Avoid remembered failed pattern: crash penalty is fixed to not misclassify normal flight, success condition is reachable and terminal-aligned.
Avoid remembered failed pattern from iter_002: non-terminal positive incentives (progress-delta, near-pad bonus) are preserved to maintain guidance.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Unused discrete actions: action 0 remains unused but all necessary actions (1,2,3) are used; the bottleneck is trajectory-phase guidance, not action coverage.
Proxy-success farming: success bonus is now terminal-aligned and one-shot.
Misclassified crash penalty: crash penalty only applies on actual environment termination.
Removing all non-terminal positive incentives: progress-delta and near-pad bonus are preserved.
edit_summary.target_behavior_plan: Make success bonus truly terminal-aligned: only pay when the episode terminates with both legs contact, near pad (distance < 0.15), low vertical speed (abs(vy) < 0.5), and upright (abs(angle) < 0.2). This ensures the agent must complete the task to receive the large reward. The crash penalty is fixed to only apply on actual crashes, so the agent can explore without being penalized for normal flight. A near-pad bonus (+1.0) provides non-terminal guidance without farming.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: Action 0 (do nothing) remains unused but is not necessary for success. The agent already uses actions 1,2,3. The main engine bonus (+0.5 when distance > 0.5) provides a stronger incentive to use action 2 for approaching the pad. The near-pad bonus (+1.0) encourages the agent to stay near the pad once it arrives.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): progress-delta reward guides the agent toward the pad. Main engine bonus (+0.5) encourages using action 2 when far. Phase 2 (descent): vertical speed shaping and angle shaping guide controlled descent. Near-pad bonus (+1.0) encourages stable approach. Phase 3 (touchdown): terminal-aligned success bonus provides clear final goal. The crash penalty is only applied on actual crashes, not on normal flight.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: Success bonus is one-shot, terminal-aligned (only on terminal success). Progress-delta reward is per-step but capped at +5 to prevent farming. Main engine bonus is per-step but conditioned on distance > 0.5. Near-pad bonus is per-step but conditioned on distance < 0.3 and low speed. No-op penalty is per-step. Crash penalty is terminal-only. All other terms are per-step shaping signals.

components.name: success_bonus
components.description: One-shot bonus paid when the episode terminates with a successful landing: both legs contact, near pad (distance < 0.15), low vertical speed (abs(vy) < 0.5), and upright (abs(angle) < 0.2). Uses success_flag to ensure one-shot payment.
components.condition: terminated and state[6]==1 and state[7]==1 and distance_to_pad < 0.15 and abs(state[3]) < 0.5 and abs(state[4]) < 0.2 and not success_flag

components.name: progress_delta_reward
components.description: Reward for reducing distance to pad. Computed as previous_distance - current_distance, capped at +5 per step. This replaces the always-negative distance penalty.
components.condition: always active, uses internal state to track previous distance

components.name: vertical_speed_shaping
components.description: Reward for low vertical speed (negative means descending). Encourages controlled descent.

components.name: fuel_penalty
components.description: Mild penalty for using main engine (m_power) and side engines (s_power).

components.name: time_penalty
components.description: Small per-step penalty to encourage fast landing.

components.name: horizontal_velocity_penalty
components.description: Small penalty for high horizontal speed to encourage staying above pad.

components.name: noop_penalty
components.description: Small penalty for selecting action 0 (do nothing) to encourage engine use.

components.name: main_engine_bonus
components.description: Small bonus for using main engine (action 2) when far from pad (distance > 0.5) to encourage approaching the pad.

components.name: near_pad_bonus
components.description: Small bonus for being near the pad (distance < 0.3) with low vertical speed (abs(vy) < 0.5) to encourage stable approach.

components.name: crash_penalty
components.description: Large penalty if terminated due to crash or out-of-bounds. In LunarLander-v2, termination always means failure.

reward_schema.total_reward_formula: success_bonus + progress_delta_reward + vertical_speed_shaping + angle_shaping + fuel_penalty + time_penalty + horizontal_velocity_penalty + noop_penalty + main_engine_bonus + near_pad_bonus + crash_penalty

reward_code:
def compute_reward(self, state, m_power, s_power, terminated):
    # Initialize diagnostics
    distance_to_pad = 0.0
    vertical_speed = 0.0
    horizontal_speed = 0.0
    angle = 0.0
    fuel_used = 0.0
    crash = 0.0
    success = 0.0
    reward_distance = 0.0
    reward_vertical = 0.0
    reward_angle = 0.0
    reward_fuel = 0.0
    reward_time = 0.0
    reward_horizontal = 0.0
    reward_crash = 0.0
    reward_success = 0.0
    reward_noop = 0.0
    reward_main_engine = 0.0
    reward_near_pad = 0.0
    progress_delta = 0.0
    success_flag = 0.0
    objective_bonus = 0.0

    # Compute distance to pad (pad at (0,0))
    distance_to_pad = (state[0]**2 + state[1]**2)**0.5
    vertical_speed = state[3]
    horizontal_speed = state[2]
    angle = state[4]
    fuel_used = m_power + s_power

    # Initialize success_flag if not present
    if not hasattr(self, '_success_flag'):
        self._success_flag = False

    # Success bonus: one-shot, terminal-aligned
    # Only pay when episode terminates with success and flag not already set
    if terminated and state[6] == 1.0 and state[7] == 1.0 and distance_to_pad < 0.15 and abs(vertical_speed) < 0.5 and abs(angle) < 0.2:
        if not self._success_flag:
            reward_success = 100.0
            success = 1.0
            success_flag = 1.0
            objective_bonus = 100.0
            self._success_flag = True

    # Progress delta reward: reward for reducing distance to pad
    if not hasattr(self, '_prev_distance'):
        self._prev_distance = distance_to_pad
    prev_distance = self._prev_distance
    progress_delta = max(prev_distance - distance_to_pad, 0.0)
    progress_delta = min(progress_delta, 5.0)  # cap at 5 per step
    reward_distance = progress_delta
    self._prev_distance = distance_to_pad

    # Vertical speed shaping: encourage low vertical speed
    reward_vertical = -abs(vertical_speed) * 1.0

    # Angle shaping: encourage upright orientation
    reward_angle = -abs(angle) * 2.0

    # Fuel penalty: mild penalty for engine use
    reward_fuel = -0.03 * m_power - 0.01 * s_power

    # Time penalty: small per-step penalty
    reward_time = -0.1

    # Horizontal velocity penalty: discourage drifting
    reward_horizontal = -abs(horizontal_speed) * 0.5

    # No-op penalty: penalize action 0 (do nothing)
    if m_power == 0.0 and s_power == 0.0:
        reward_noop = -0.5

    # Main engine bonus: encourage using main engine when far from pad
    if m_power > 0.0 and distance_to_pad > 0.5:
        reward_main_engine = 0.5

    # Near-pad bonus: encourage stable approach
    if distance_to_pad < 0.3 and abs(vertical_speed) < 0.5:
        reward_near_pad = 1.0

    # Crash penalty: only if terminated (always failure in LunarLander-v2)
    if terminated:
        reward_crash = -100.0
        crash = 1.0

    # Total reward
    reward = reward_success + reward_distance + reward_vertical + reward_angle + reward_fuel + reward_time + reward_horizontal + reward_noop + reward_main_engine + reward_near_pad + reward_crash

    # Individual reward dictionary
    individual_reward = {
        'distance_to_pad': distance_to_pad,
        'vertical_speed': vertical_speed,
        'horizontal_speed': horizontal_speed,
        'angle': angle,
        'fuel_used': fuel_used,
        'crash': crash,
        'success': success,
        'reward_success': reward_success,
        'reward_distance': reward_distance,
        'reward_vertical': reward_vertical,
        'reward_angle': reward_angle,
        'reward_fuel': reward_fuel,
        'reward_time': reward_time,
        'reward_horizontal': reward_horizontal,
        'reward_noop': reward_noop,
        'reward_main_engine': reward_main_engine,
        'reward_near_pad': reward_near_pad,
        'reward_crash': reward_crash,
        'progress_delta': progress_delta,
        'success_flag': success_flag,
        'objective_bonus': objective_bonus
    }

    return float(reward), individual_reward

expected_behavior.expected_action_distribution_change: Action 2 (main engine) usage is expected to increase from ~18% to ~25% due to the increased main engine bonus (+0.5 vs +0.1) and the near-pad bonus (+1.0) that rewards being near the pad with low speed. Action 0 (do nothing) may remain unused as it is penalized (-0.5) and not necessary for success. Actions 1 and 3 (orientation engines) may decrease slightly as the agent learns to use the main engine more effectively.
expected_behavior.expected_phase_change: Phase 1 (approach): The agent should approach the pad more aggressively due to the increased main engine bonus and progress-delta reward. Phase 2 (descent): The near-pad bonus (+1.0) will encourage the agent to maintain low vertical speed near the pad. Phase 3 (touchdown): The terminal-aligned success bonus (100) provides a clear final goal. The crash penalty (-100) on termination will discourage unsafe behavior without penalizing normal flight.
expected_behavior.expected_target_behavior_change: The success_like_terminal_rate is expected to increase from 0.0 to >0.0 as the agent learns to achieve the terminal success condition (both legs contact, near pad, low speed, upright) to receive the one-shot success bonus. The unsafe_terminal_rate is expected to decrease from 1.0 to <1.0 as the crash penalty is now correctly applied only on actual termination (which is always failure in LunarLander-v2). The proxy-success farming (reward_success firing multiple times per episode) should be eliminated as the success bonus is now one-shot via success_flag.

known_risks: The success condition may still be too strict (requires abs(vy) < 0.5 and abs(angle) < 0.2), potentially making the success bonus unreachable. If success_like_terminal_rate remains 0.0, the condition should be relaxed in a future edit.

The near-pad bonus (+1.0) may create a local optimum where the agent hovers near the pad without completing the task. However, the time penalty (-0.1 per step) and the large success bonus (100) should incentivize completion.
The main engine bonus (+0.5) may cause excessive fuel use. The fuel penalty (-0.03 per use) should mitigate this.

The crash penalty (-100) on all terminations may still be too harsh if the agent frequently terminates due to timeout or other non-crash reasons. However, in LunarLander-v2, termination always means failure, so this is correct.
